          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

          type: string
          minLength: 1

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison

            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits. For example '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.

          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9()+.\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
